svg.aria-label: Pipeline architecture: origination layer and relayer off-chain, protocol layer on-chain, capital layer of MPC custody accounts and a USD bank account; every privileged call goes through the access manager.
svg.font-family: Graphik LC, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Pipeline architecture: origination layer and relayer off-chain, protocol layer on-chain, capital layer of MPC custody accounts and a USD bank account; every privileged call goes through the access manager.
svg.text: Admin, Risk Council, Trustee, Cash Reporter, Guardian,
maps every privileged call to a role
one record per facility: terms, lender shares, lifecycle
security records, inspection reports, prices, LTV,
pays USDC from the buffer; burns PLUSD
cash book; mints for wires, interest and fees
the pool's share of a defaulted
